fields.name: title
fields.description: Short saga title shown in the in-game quest log (Norwegian flavour is fine).

fields.name: description
fields.description: Quest-giver flavour text. Write it with the player; fit Classic/Forever lore. Newlines OK.

fields.name: objectives
fields.description: Structured goals (NOT plain strings). Each object needs id (slug), type, text (Norwegian log line). Types: location — map_id (Elwynn Forest Classic=37), x/y (0–1), radius, optional zone/subzone (client language; use | for alternatives); interact — npc and/or object (exact UnitName, client language); collect — item_id, count, optional item_name; kill — npc (creature name), count. Example interact: {"id":"tharynn","type":"interact","text":"Snakk med Tharynn Bouden","npc":"Tharynn Bouden"}. Example kill: {"id":"rabbits","type":"kill","text":"Drep 5 kaniner","npc":"Rabbit","count":5}.

fields.name: created_by
fields.description: Author BattleTag (e.g. Magnus#2231). Creates the GutSaga player if missing.

fields.name: party_quest
fields.description: true = every eligible character can take it; false = only assigned_character_ids.

fields.name: reward
fields.description: Reward flavour line (shown in-game; not a real item grant).

fields.name: min_level
fields.description: Minimum character level. Omit for no gate.

fields.name: assigned_character_ids
fields.description: GutSaga character UUIDs from list_characters. Use when party_quest=false.

fields.name: objectives_ordered
fields.description: If true, goals must be completed in array order.

fields.name: active
fields.description: Defaults true. false retires the saga.

fields.name: image
fields.description: Optional cover image (PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF, max 8 MiB). Shown under the description in the addon after companion sync. Omit to create without a cover.

fields.name: quest
fields.description: Created GutSaga quest (has_image true when a cover was uploaded)
